title: Severe bleeding
plain: Heavy bleeding that does not stop. Firm pressure stops most bleeding: press and keep pressing.

doNotGive.reason: Aspirin and ibuprofen make bleeding worse

steps.text: Press hard on the wound with a clean dressing. Don't lift it to look.
Lie the person down and raise the injured part above the heart if you can.

steps.question: Has the bleeding stopped or slowed a lot?

steps.text: Add more dressings on top and keep pressing. On an arm or leg, use the tourniquet from the kit as the checklist shows.
Bandage it firmly. Check that fingers or toes stay warm and pink.

escalation: Bleeding not controlled after 30 minutes, or the person is pale, cold or confused: follow EMG-SEVERE-BLEEDING with the CMO. Earth is informed.
